Practice Areas

Compassionate counsel. Relentless results. If you were hurt by someone else’s negligence, we can help.

Motor Vehicle Accidents

Collisions are complex — insurance layers, medical bills, lost wages. We move fast to secure evidence and protect your rights.

  • Car, truck, and motorcycle crashes
  • Rideshare (Uber/Lyft) and delivery vehicles
  • Uninsured/underinsured motorist claims
  • Catastrophic injury and wrongful death

Premises Liability (Slip, Trip & Fall)

Property owners must keep spaces reasonably safe. When they don’t, injuries happen — we hold them accountable.

  • Spills, unsafe flooring, debris
  • Ice/snow, poor lighting, broken handrails
  • Negligent security and assaults
  • Code violations and landlord negligence

Workplace & Construction Injuries

Beyond workers’ comp, third parties may be liable — contractors, property owners, equipment makers.

  • Falls from heights, scaffolding failures
  • Electrocution and burn injuries
  • Forklift, crane, and heavy equipment incidents
  • Third-party negligence claims

Medical Negligence

Medicine is complex. We work with leading experts to analyze care and expose preventable errors.

  • Misdiagnosis and delayed diagnosis
  • Surgical and anesthesia errors
  • Birth injuries and neonatal negligence
  • Hospital-acquired infections

Defective Products

Dangerous consumer and industrial products cause life-altering harm. We pursue manufacturers and distributors.

  • Automotive defects and tire failures
  • Household appliances and electronics
  • Industrial machinery and tools
  • Failure to warn and design defects

Dog Bites & Animal Attacks

We secure coverage for medical care, scarring, trauma, and lost income after animal attacks.

  • Homeowner and renter insurance claims
  • Facial scarring and reconstructive needs
  • Children’s claims handled with care

Pedestrian & Bicycle

Vulnerable road users face unique risks. We reconstruct scenes and demand accountability.

  • Crosswalk and intersection impacts
  • Dooring and bike lane violations
  • Hit-and-run investigations

Wrongful Death

We honor your loved one’s story while pursuing justice and financial security for your family.

  • Estate and probate coordination
  • Loss of support and companionship
  • Sensitive, family-first communication

Don’t see your situation?

Call {{PHONE}} or send a message. If we can’t help, we’ll try to point you to someone who can.

Truck Collision — Brain Injury

Our Proven Process

Transparent, proactive, and built to win — while keeping you informed at every step.

  1. 1) Free Case Evaluation

    We listen. We learn the facts, identify deadlines, and outline a roadmap. You’ll know exactly what comes next.

    Start now

  2. 2) Investigation

    We secure police reports, photos, witness statements, vehicle data, site inspections, and medical records before evidence disappears.

    • Preservation letters within 24–48 hours
    • Experts retained early where needed
    • Liability and damages strategy memo

  3. 3) Treatment & Support

    Your health first. We help coordinate care and manage bills and liens to reduce stress and protect your net recovery.

  4. 4) Demand & Negotiation

    We prepare a compelling demand package backed by records, expert opinions, and economic analysis. Then we negotiate relentlessly.

  5. 5) Litigation & Trial

    If insurers won’t be fair, we file suit. We’re courtroom-ready with visuals, exhibits, and experts to tell your story.

Fees & Costs

We work on a contingency fee. You pay no attorney’s fees unless we recover money for you. We advance case costs and only get reimbursed from the recovery.

Communication

Expect regular updates and fast responses. You’ll have direct contact with your attorney and a dedicated case manager.

Let’s talk about your case.

It’s free, confidential, and there’s no obligation.

Frequently Asked Questions

If you don’t see your question, call us anytime at {{PHONE}}.

How much does it cost to hire you?

We work on a contingency fee. You pay no attorney’s fees unless we recover money for you. We advance case costs and are reimbursed from the recovery.

Do I have to go to court?

Most cases resolve through settlement or mediation. That said, we prepare every case as if it will be tried — it’s the best way to maximize value.

How long will my case take?

Timelines vary based on treatment, liability disputes, and court schedules. Many claims resolve within 6–12 months; litigation can take longer.

What is my case worth?

Value depends on liability, medical evidence, lost income, and the impact on your life. We provide an honest, evolving assessment as evidence develops.

Will you help with medical bills?

Yes. We coordinate billing, PIP/MedPay, health insurance liens, and letters of protection to reduce out-of-pocket stress.

What should I do after a crash?
  1. Get medical care immediately.
  2. Photograph vehicles, scene, and injuries.
  3. Exchange info and obtain a police report.
  4. Call us before speaking with insurers.

Still have questions?

We’re happy to help. Reach out now.
